speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: Master Shakespeare? Kettleby. From Somerset House, and on the Sabbath, for which I ask your pardon and not my lord's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have the pardon, sir. Say the errand.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: My lord's son-in-law, Sir Edward Hoby, keeps a supper on Tuesday at his house in Canon Row, for a guest he is particular to please. He has written this day to bid you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: To bid the company, or to bid me?

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: The company, after supper, with the king play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The king, sir? My lord said in plain words—

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: My lord said not at court. This is a gentleman's parlour, behind a gentleman's door, and the gentleman is his daughter's husband.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: Sir Edward has heard there is more of the play than Shoreditch has been let see. He desires it whole.

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: I repeat a word; I do not advise upon it. Come by water at five. Twelve at table, and a small room.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Does my lord know whose guest it is?

speaker: ambrose_kettleby
text: My lord knows whose house it is. God keep you.
